specs.subject: Governed multi-environment access to Claude Platform on AWS
specs.mechanism: Show three distinct caller environments feeding a governed identity and policy boundary before reaching the model service, with approved-path routing and audit evidence separated from model inference.
specs.composition: Layered infrastructure cutaway: developer environment and production workload on the left; a central identity/policy boundary with credentials and approval gates; Claude Platform on AWS on the right; an audit trail beneath the access path. Use nested security zones, keyed paths, small non-text geometric markers and detailed connectors rather than generic boxes.
restrictions: Do not imply universal access or specific entitlements.
No credentials, code, console screenshots or fabricated IAM policy syntax.

specs.subject: Gemini 4 Argon for long-horizon professional workflows
specs.mechanism: Show a long-horizon task moving through planning, sustained execution and verification while access remains staged rather than broadly open.
specs.composition: Detailed long-trajectory workbench: a substantial task packet enters a planning layer, branches through several abstract work artifacts and iterative execution checkpoints, then converges on verification; a separate staged-access boundary surrounds the model path. Visually emphasize sustained multi-step work and review, not benchmark scores.
restrictions: No benchmark numbers, pricing, vulnerability details or unsupported performance comparison.
Do not depict broad public availability.

specs.subject: Generative personalization tied to contextual-bandit decision and measurement loops
specs.mechanism: Audience context and generated variants feed a contextual-bandit decision; a selected experience produces an observed outcome that updates the policy for later decisions.
specs.composition: Professional closed-loop decision diagram with rich detail: context features and multiple content variants enter a central decision engine; one path is selected into an experience panel; measurable outcome signals return through a learning lane to the decision policy. Use a true feedback loop with clear directionality and multiple candidate variants.
restrictions: No fabricated conversion percentages or winner claims.
No people, ad screenshots or brand UI.

specs.subject: Adapting Amazon Nova to organization-specific retail moderation policy
specs.mechanism: Organization policy is translated into labeled examples and evaluation criteria, used to adapt the model, and then checked against a held-out evaluation set before production moderation with a review loop.
specs.composition: Detailed policy-to-model pipeline: policy documents fan into labeled examples and a decision taxonomy; Amazon Nova sits inside an adaptation stage; a separate evaluation set challenges the adapted model; production moderation outputs route uncertain cases into a review loop that feeds future policy/example maintenance.
restrictions: No prohibited-content examples, no fabricated accuracy metrics, no product interface.
Do not imply fully autonomous policy authority.

specs.subject: Reusable Perplexity business Skills for recurring operational work
specs.mechanism: A reusable Skill packages required inputs, maintained instructions and an expected output format, then applies that procedure across recurring business tasks.
specs.composition: Rich operating-knowledge plate: central Business Skill package shown as a structured reusable module with internal layers for inputs, instructions and expected output; four distinct recurring work lanes for finance, marketing, operations and hiring connect to the same maintained package; a maintenance/version path loops back into the Skill.
restrictions: No credit offers, pricing, card imagery or product UI.
Do not show people or generic chat bubbles.

specs.subject: OpenAI Dots as always-on agents with continuing responsibilities
specs.mechanism: A Dot receives a standing goal, operates through its cloud computer and connected apps, incorporates user feedback and returns important work for a review checkpoint.
specs.composition: Detailed responsibility-loop architecture: standing goal enters the Dot; the agent works inside a clearly bounded cloud-computer environment connected to several abstract app/service endpoints; progress and artifacts accumulate over time; feedback modifies future work; important outputs pass through a review checkpoint. Convey persistence and ongoing responsibility without depicting a dashboard.
restrictions: No Slack/Teams screenshots, no product UI, no usage or pricing claims, no autonomous high-impact action implication.
No people or humanoid agent icon.
